adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed with `&&` between `isTeamAdmin(...)` and `isTeamOwner(...)`, meaning a user must be both admin and owner to pass (`true && false` => `false`). This value is then used in the permission gate `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee) throw FORBIDDEN`, which would incorrectly deny access to team admins who are not also owners. The variable name and typical permission intent suggest it should be `||` (admin OR owner).
